messages:
triage-bot: SEV: Serving errors and node flapping in infer-pool-usw. 4 nodes NotReady in 7m, multiple serving-runtime pods CrashLoopBackOff. Symptoms observed: GPU resets, host OOM kills. Paging oncall @maria.

maria (oncall): ack — joining. grabbing node/pod events and logs now.

kevin: seeing kernel OOM lines on infer-usw-4: 'Out of memory: Killed process 29384 (serve) total-vm...' and repeated GPU reset messages in dmesg.

nina: pod logs from serving-runtime show repeated 'cuInit failed' followed by segfault, then container restarts with ExitCode 137 (OOMKilled).

maria: quick triage: likely NV driver + kernel combo causing intermittent resets while runtime allocs spike. checking recent node image rollouts.

devops: starting traffic steering to reduce pressure on infer-pool-usw. Routing plan: shift 50% steady traffic to dedicated-usw and 30% to eu-west. applying CPU-quantized fallback for non-low-latency routes.

prod-observability: customer impact estimate: 3.8% error rate on /v1/chat and /v1/generate for last 10m, p50 latency up 220ms for affected pool. Flagging top 5 customers.

maria: plan: cordon and drain the NotReady/flapping nodes, try safe reboot and driver restart where possible. If reboots fail, mark nodes for reprovision and scale up dedicated fallback.

infra-bot: kubectl get nodes -l pool=infer-usw -o wide
```
NAME           STATUS    ROLES   AGE   VERSION
infer-usw-1    Ready     node    11d   v1.26
infer-usw-2    NotReady  node    3d    v1.26
infer-usw-3    NotReady  node    5h    v1.26
infer-usw-4    Ready     node    19d   v1.26
infer-usw-5    NotReady  node    40m   v1.26
```

kevin: infer-usw-3 and -5 show kubelet restarts every ~30s in journalctl. suspect host agent crash loop; will escalate to infra team.

nina: applying temporary pod spec override on cpu-fallback to reduce batch size and max_tokens to limit memory pressure while steering.

devops: enabling autoscale to bring up extra dedicated workers in us-west and eu-west pools. watch for credits/cost spike.

maria: draining infer-usw-3 now. kubectl drain infer-usw-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data.

infra-bot: drain complete for infer-usw-3, pods evicted. rebooting node and restarting nvidia-driver.service + kubelet.

kevin: after reboot, dmesg on infer-usw-3 shows fewer GPU resets. bringing node to schedulable after 2m soak.

maria: infer-usw-5 still flapping NotReady; kubelet shows segfault in host-agent binary. infra is investigating core dump. marking infer-usw-5 unschedulable and leaving taint.

devops: routing update: reduced steady traffic steering to dedicated-usw -> 45%. monitoring EU fallback latency. added rule: if eu-west p95 > 150ms, move bursts to dedicated-capacity only.

prod-observability: error rate down to 0.9% after drains and steering, p50 latency trending down. continuing to monitor 15m.

nina: thumbs up :thumbsup: — keeping small canary of cpu-variant at 10% for sensitive customers.

infra-bot: infra team patched host-agent on reprovision pipeline to use driver 535.78 instead of 535.86 for the affected image; marking nodes created after t=5743200000 as safe.

maria: handing pager to kevin for rotation relief. kevin, I'll leave taints on infer-usw-5/2 until infra confirms repaired image and we reprovision.

kevin (oncall): taking it. filing incident ticket INC-2026-4592 with timeline, mitigations, affected customers. assigning RCA to nina/infra team.

triage-bot: Incident state -> MONITORING. Keep thread updated with any regression.

maria: follow-ups: 1) reprovision flapping nodes with patched image, 2) run stress test to reproduce GPU reset under controlled load, 3) update image rollout gating to include kernel-driver compatibility check. Will add to RCA.

kevin: noted. closing pager in 30m if no new NotReady events. thanks all.
